codesFaq.question: Does Rarest Answer use redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: No. Rarest Answer is a browser trivia game. There is nothing to redeem.

codesFaq.question: Why is a codes table on this page?
codesFaq.answer: This site does not publish redeem codes. If you see a code here, treat it as unrelated to Rarest Answer and check the page that actually owns it.

codesFaq.question: Where do the trivia answers come from?
codesFaq.answer: Answer lists are built from Wikidata. Rarity uses public Wikipedia pageview statistics, or Wiktionary pageviews for English interjections. An answer is ranked only against the other answers to the same prompt.

codesFaq.question: Do answers expire?
codesFaq.answer: Trivia answers are not promo codes. A list can still be incomplete, and pageview ranks can change as people read different articles.

items.question: Is Rarest Answer free?
items.answer: Yes. The daily round, Unlimited mode, and the category rounds are free in the browser. There is no account.

items.question: When does the daily round change?
items.answer: A new daily round starts at midnight in your own time zone. Everyone on the same local date gets the same seven prompts.

items.question: How does scoring work?
items.answer: A correct answer scores more when it is rarer among the accepted answers for that prompt. The six tiers are Common (5), Familiar (10), Uncommon (20), Rare (40), Epic (70), and Legendary (100).

items.question: Where do the answers come from?
items.answer: Prompt lists are compiled from Wikidata (CC0) and Wikipedia or Wiktionary pageview counts. An answer is ranked only against the other answers to the same prompt. A real name can be missing when that public data does not include it. English interjections use Wiktionary pageviews. The other published prompts use English Wikipedia pageviews.

items.question: Can I play more than the daily round?
items.answer: Yes. Unlimited mode deals more prompts, and each category — geography, animals, food, sports, movies and TV, music, science, and history — can be played on its own. Streaks and stats stay in this browser.
